dresser_length_tradeoff.basis: All catalog dressers/chests that fit the owner’s west-wall span, plus the parent’s hypothetical size example. Dresser 2 in from north wall; queen 2 in from east wall. Stop range spans camera-fit and survey hinge. Thin-leaf reference gap and full-thickness slab gap are local bed-foot gaps, not route widths; installed stops/handles unmeasured. About 105 degrees is owner-acceptable; more opening is preferred.
